42 – 27 + 6 = 21

21 = 21

questions.question: Who signed the treaty of Alinagar with the British?
questions.questionHtml: Who signed the treaty of Alinagar with the British?
questions.solution:
Siraj-ud-Daula signed the treaty of Alinagar with the British.

  • On 9 February 1757, the Treaty of Alinagar was concluded between Robert Clive of the British East India Company and  Muhammad Siraj Ud Daul Mirza(the Nawab of Bengal).
  • On the basis of the terms of the deal, the Nawab would accept all the provisions of the 1717 Farmman of Mughal Emperor Farrukh Siyar. In fact, all British goods going through Bengal should be excluded from customs duty.
  • Siraj ud-Daulah was Bengal's last independent Nawab. The end of his reign marked the beginning of the British East India Company's control over Bengal and, later, almost all of India.
  • Robert Clive was the first British governor to occupy the Bengal presidency.
  • He started as an officer of the British Army and the East India Company (EIC) who established the military and political hegemony of the EIC by taking possession of Bengal.

questions.question: Constantan is an alloy of copper and _______.
questions.questionHtml: Constantan is an alloy of copper and _______.
questions.solution:
Constantan is an alloy of copper and nickel.

  • It normally consists of 55% copper and 45% nickel.
  • Its key characteristic is the low thermal variation of its resistance, which is consistent over a large range of temperatures.
  • It was discovered by Edward Weston in 1887.
  • It is often used to form thermocouples with wires made of iron, copper, or chromium.
  • It has an extremely strong negative Seebeck coefficient above 0 degree Celsius, resulting in good temperature sensitivity.

questions.question: What does 'C' stand for in ITCZ?
questions.questionHtml: What does 'C' stand for in ITCZ?
questions.solution:
In ITCZ, "C" is stand for Convergence.

  • The Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) is the zone that covers the Earth, near the equator.
  • Where trade winds from the Northern and Southern Hemispheres come together.
  • The sun and warm water of the equator heat up the air in the ITCZ, increase its temperature, and keep it buoyant.
  • With the aid of the convergence of the industrial winds, the buoyant air is rising.
  • When the air increases, it spreads and cools, releasing concentrated heat in an almost endless cycle of thunderstorms.

questions.question: The rating for a fuse used in a household electric circuit is provided on the basis of:
questions.questionHtml: The rating for a fuse used in a household electric circuit is provided on the basis of:
questions.solution:
The rating for a fuse used in a household electric circuit is provided on the basis of the current.

  • The fuse is used to provide overcurrent protection.
  • The main component is a metal wire or strip that melts when too much current flows through it, stopping or interrupting the current.
  • It is a sacrificial device; once the fuse has been operated, the open circuit must be replaced or rewired, depending on the type.
  • The Wiring Regulations usually define the maximum current rate of fuse for particular circuits.
  • Short circuits, overload, uneven loads, or device failure are the primary or some of the reasons for fuse operation.

  • Dermatology is a field of medicine that deals with the skin.

  • Hydrogeology is the study of groundwater.

questions.question: Which among the following is a non-biodegradable waste?
questions.questionHtml: Which among the following is a non-biodegradable waste?
questions.solution:
Plastic is a non-biodegradable waste.

Key Points

  • Non-biodegradable material can be characterized as a category of substance that can not be broken down by natural organisms and acts as a source of pollution.
  • Non-biodegradable waste is a waste that can not be decomposed or dissolved by natural chemicals.
  • They have existed on earth for thousands of years without any deterioration.
  • Dead animals, Vegetables and Flowers are the biodegradable waste.
  • Biodegradable material can be described as a substance that can be decomposed by bacteria or other natural organisms and does not contribute to pollution.
  • Biodegradable waste is waste material that is and can be contaminated by natural causes such as organisms (e.g. bacteria, fungi, etc.), abiotic elements such as temperature, UV, oxygen, etc.

questions.question: Under which Amendment to the Constitution of India was Goods and Services Tax imposed?
questions.questionHtml: Under which Amendment to the Constitution of India was Goods and Services Tax imposed?
questions.solution:

  • This amendment introduced the National Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India as of 1st July 2017.
  • It was adopted as the One Hundred and Twenty-Second Amendment Bill to the Constitution of India.
  • The Goods and Services Tax (GST) is a value-added tax (VAT) imposed as a systematic indirect tax levy on the production, sale, and use of products and services at the national level.
  • It shall absorb all indirect taxes imposed on goods and services by the central and state governments of India.

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 280900 in 2 years at 6% per annum, interest compounded annually. The sum is:
questions.questionHtml: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 280900 in 2 years at 6% per annum, interest compounded annually. The sum is:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Rate = 6% = 6/100 = 3/50

Ratio of Principal to Amount for 1 year = 50 : 53

Ratio of Principal to Amount for 2 years = (50)2 : (53)2 = 2500 : 2809

Given Amount = 2809 units = Rs. 280900 ⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 100

Principal = 2500 units = 2500 × 100 = Rs. 250000

∴ The correct answer is Rs. 250000.

Alternate Method

Given:

Amount (A) = Rs. 280900

Time (T) = 2 years

Rate (R) = 6% per annum

Formula Used:

A = P(1 + R/100)T

Calculation:

⇒ 280900 = P(1 + 6/100)2

⇒ 280900 = P(1 + 3/50)2

⇒ 280900 = P(53/50)2

⇒ 280900 = P × (2809 / 2500)

⇒ P = 280900 × (2500 / 2809)

⇒ P = 100 × 2500 = 250000

∴ The correct answer is Rs. 250000.

Additional Information

Compound Interest Formula

When interest is compounded annually, Amount A = P(1 + R/100)T, where P is the principal, R is the rate of interest, and T is the time period in years.

Effective Rate of Interest

For 2 years, the effective compound interest rate can be directly calculated using the successive percentage change formula: Reff = R + R + (R × R) ÷ 100.

Difference Between CI and SI

For 2 years, the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on a sum P at rate R% is given by Diff = P(R/100)2.
